name: Anatomical Sciences and Neurobiology PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Application deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual date; review starts December 15; fall admission only.

english.note: Central IELTS minimum has no subscore below 5; PTE Academic 55 with no subscore below 53. Country/qualifying-degree exemptions apply; consult official policy and program-specific requirements.

documents: Official transcripts of all college work
requirements.note: Bachelor's degree with some science background; no specific undergraduate major required. TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo for nonnative international applicants; U.S. bachelor's/advanced degree exempts. A non-refundable application fee is required; amount not stated on opened central pages. Limited departmental fee waivers may be available case by case; international applicants should confirm eligibility.

funding.note: Selected IPIBS fellows receive support. Published undated IPIBS stipend $33,000, increasing to $35,000 after candidacy, tuition waiver and health insurance. Fellowship selection and continued support depend on program conditions.
